semantics: coa_dungeon_boss_kit columns are read from explicit INSERT header; SmartAI rows are separately parsed by the explicit INSERT header. eventType 0 timer, 2 health, 4 pull in kit source comments; target 1 self, 2 victim, 5 random. Difficulty value requires runtime validation.
cautions: Do not conflate initial/repeat values with observed in-game timers
Some SmartAI actions are summons, dialogue or state changes rather than casts
Source rows can be overridden by later migrations
Check base_points damage corrections and cast_flags before enabling warnings
